name: Caledonia Farmers Market
description: Caledonia Farmers Market is a farmers market in 9957 Cherry Valley Avenue Southeast, MI, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Hours and availability change with the season, so confirm before visiting.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
